# Separator-panel tiling (Continual-ARC)

For task `task-3944b54a`, identify full-length separator rows and columns (in the observed instance, color 4). These partition the grid into panels. One panel contains a pattern while the others are mostly background (color 9); copy the source pattern into every corresponding blank panel, preserving the separator lines and the source panel. Observed demonstration: a 4-row pattern in a 7-column-wide panel was copied into the two blank panels below it, with full-width separator rows retained.

## Procedure
1. Find rows or columns that are uniform and act as dividers.
2. Split the grid at those lines into equal-sized panels.
3. Locate the populated/source panel and derive its exact pattern, including background cells.
4. Copy that pattern into every blank panel in the corresponding layout; preserve dividers.
5. Check dimensions and all separator coordinates before submitting.

# Tiling patterns across divider-separated panels

When an ARC grid has full-length uniform separator rows or columns, split the grid into panels. A panel containing a pattern may serve as the source; blank panels of matching dimensions should receive an exact copy of that pattern, while separators remain untouched.

5. Preserve divider cells; check the output dimensions and separator coordinates.
